import json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).parent
cases=[('positive',{'a':2,'b':3},5),('negative',{'a':-7,'b':2},-5),('zero',{'a':0,'b':0},0),('decimal',{'a':1.25,'b':2.5},3.75),('missing',{'a':2},None),('wrong-type',{'a':'2','b':3},None),('extra-field',{'a':2,'b':3,'c':4},None)]
results=[]
for name,args,expected in cases:
 cmd=['npx','--yes','@mcpjam/cli@6.2.2','tools','call','--url','http://fixture:8765/mcp','--access-token',os.environ['MCP_SERVER_TOKEN'],'--tool-name','add','--tool-args',json.dumps(args),'--quiet','--format','json']
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
 try: payload=json.loads(r.stdout)
 except ValueError: payload={'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr}
 good=(r.returncode==0 and payload.get('structuredContent',{}).get('sum')==expected and not payload.get('isError')) if expected is not None else (r.returncode!=0 or payload.get('isError',False))
 results.append({'case':name,'arguments':args,'expectedSum':expected,'exitCode':r.returncode,'passed':good,'response':payload})
(root/'arithmetic-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(x['passed'] for x in results) else 1)
